scope: NCAA FBS playing rules affecting scoring, possession, clock and game end, seasons 2014-2025

conventions.null: not verified from an opened source, or not applicable (see notes)

overtime.timeouts: 1 per team per extra period; unused timeouts do not carry over
overtime.notes: No maximum number of extra periods is stated in Rule 3-1-3 (max_overtime_periods null = no stated limit). Pre-2019: every extra period is a full possession series from the 25; two-point try mandatory from the 3rd period.

scoring.try_after_td_as_time_expires_in_q4: not attempted unless the point(s) would affect the outcome
scoring.notes: Try scores per 8-1-1 'Successful Try: Touchdown 2, Field Goal or Safety 1'. A.R. 8-3-2-VII: Team B interception returned on a try = 2 points for Team B. A.R. 8-3-2-I/II: safety by Team B on a try = 1 point for Team A.

clock.out_of_bounds_ball_carrier: stop; restart on ready-for-play signal, except with fewer than 2:00 left in a half (restart on snap)
clock.after_score: stop; restart when the following free kick is legally touched in the field of play
clock.period_extension_triggers: accepted live-ball foul (not Team A loss-of-down foul), offsetting fouls, inadvertent whistle; TD as time expires -> try

kickoff.free_kick_out_of_bounds_receiving_option: 5 yards from previous spot, 5 yards from dead-ball spot, or ball at hash 30 yards beyond kicking team's restraining line
kickoff.notes: Fair catch of a free kick: ball belongs to Team B at the spot of the catch (6-5-1-a).

halftime.quarter_break_q1_q3: teams switch goals; possession, down, distance and spot carry over
halftime.end_of_half_no_time: half ends when time expires and ball is dead unless extended for an untimed down (see clock.period_extended_for_untimed_down_in) or a try after a TD
halftime.notes: The 2013-14 book (S1) gives the toss winner the option to 'defer his selection to the second half' and says the referee obtains second-half options, but does not contain the explicit sentence 'For the second half the loser of the toss, or the winner who chooses option 3, shall choose...' which first appears in the 2016-17 book (S2). The value is therefore verified only for the deferral case in 2014-2015.

clock.out_of_bounds_ball_carrier: stop; restart on ready-for-play signal before the Two-Minute Timeout in Q2/Q4, on snap after it
clock.after_score: stop; restart when the following free kick is legally touched in the field of play
clock.two_minute_timeout_detail: Referee stops the clock at exactly 2:00 of Q2 and Q4 when the ball is dead, or when the ball becomes dead if a down is live at 2:00 (Rule 3-3-5); play clock set to 25.
clock.ten_second_runoff_window: after the Two-Minute Timeout in Q2/Q4
clock.clock_on_snap_option_after_foul_by_leadi: after Two-Minute Timeout; foul by team ahead or either team if tied
clock.period_extension_triggers: accepted live-ball foul (not Team A loss-of-down foul), offsetting fouls, inadvertent whistle; TD as time expires -> try
clock.notes: 2016: Rule 3-4-3 added the offended team's option to start the clock on the snap after a foul by the team ahead in the last two minutes. 2018: 40-second play clock after free kicks and touchdowns (3-2-4); replay 10-second runoff (12-3-6). 2020: if replay restores time at end of a half with the clock to start on the ready signal, at least 3 seconds must remain (12-3-6). 2023: first-down clock stop only in the last 2:00 of Q2/Q4; extension of periods only at the end of Q2/Q4; no consecutive charged timeouts by the same team in one dead-ball period. 2025: 3-5-3-b clock-reset option for a defensive 12-men foul after the Two-Minute Timeout. 2024: Two-Minute Timeout; 'two minutes' triggers in 3-3-2, 3-4-3, 3-4-4 and injury runoff re-keyed to after the Two-Minute Timeout; 10-second runoff window widened from final 1:00 to after the Two-Minute Timeout.

kickoff.free_kick_out_of_bounds_receiving_option: 5 yards from previous spot, 5 yards from dead-ball spot, or ball at hash 30 yards beyond kicking team's restraining line
kickoff.notes: 2018: fair catch of a free kick behind Team B's 25 is put in play at Team B's 25 (6-5-1-a).

halftime.quarter_break_q1_q3: teams switch goals; possession, down, distance and spot carry over
halftime.end_of_half_no_time: half ends when time expires and ball is dead unless extended for an untimed down (see clock.period_extended_for_untimed_down_in) or a try after a TD

items: 3-1-3-h extra-period timeouts modified (1 per team in OT1, OT2; 1 total from OT3); media/mandatory break only after OT1/OT2
3-5-3-b: after the Two-Minute Timeout, a defensive 12-men-participating foul lets the offended team reset the game clock to the time at the snap; clock restarts on the snap
3-3-2-d-12: game clock starts on the snap after a Two-Minute Timeout (explicit from 2025)
